# Mole UI

> Mole UI is a lightweight, accessible React 18/19 component library for MoleDAO. The npm package name is `moledao`. It uses TypeScript and native CSS variables, with no Tailwind or CSS-in-JS runtime.

## AI quick start

1. Install/import components from `moledao` or a documented subpath.
2. Import `moledao/styles.css` exactly once in the application entry point.
3. Prefer wrapping the application in `MoleProvider` for theme, density, motion, locale, and runtime preferences.
4. Use only props and enum values listed in the manifest. Do not invent component names, variants, icon names, or states.
5. Forward normal DOM props when the manifest says a component inherits native attributes.
6. Follow every accessibility rule in the selected component entry.

```tsx
import { Button, Input, MoleProvider } from 'moledao';
import 'moledao/styles.css';

export function App() {
  return (
    <MoleProvider locale="zh-CN" theme="system">
      <Input label="项目名称" clearable />
      <Button variant="primary">创建项目</Button>
    </MoleProvider>
  );
}
```

## Machine-readable API

- Public endpoint `/component-manifest.json`: canonical structured index of components, utilities, props, defaults, enum values, accessibility rules, icon names, tokens, examples, and source locations.
- [Manifest source](docs/ai/component-manifest.json): repository copy of the same JSON document.
- [Package exports](packages/ui/package.json): authoritative runtime and subpath exports.
- [TypeScript public API](packages/ui/src/index.ts): authoritative exported symbols and types.
- [Component source](packages/ui/src): authoritative behavior when the manifest and implementation differ.

## Component selection

- Actions: `Button`
- Text entry: `Input`
- Boolean preference: `Toggle`
- Contextual hint: `Tooltip`
- Static pictogram: `Icon`
- Stateful motion pictogram: `AnimatedIcon`; use `LockIcon` only as the lock shorthand
- Loading state: `Spinner`
- Text hierarchy/state: `Typography`
- App theme/runtime boundary: `MoleProvider`
- Below-the-fold rendering: `DeferredRender`

## Required accessibility behavior

- Give icon-only `Button` instances an `aria-label`.
- Give standalone informative `Icon` and `AnimatedIcon` instances an `aria-label`; decorative icons are hidden automatically.
- Always provide `Toggle.label`.
- Give `Input` either a visible `label` or an `aria-label`.
- Give `Spinner` a task-specific `label` when the default “加载中” is insufficient.
- Pass one focusable React element as `Tooltip.children`.

## Validation

Run `corepack pnpm check` after changing component code. The package supports React `^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0` and targets ES2018.
